## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org), for example `fix(chatgpt): keep the search dialog filtered`.
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated for the change.
- [ ] If a site changed, its fixtures are refreshed and contain no personal data.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots in light and dark mode.
